{{Mornar Bar sections}}
'''FK Mornar Bar''' is a [[Montenegro|Montenegrin]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in the coastal town of [[Bar, Montenegro|Bar]], which competes in the [[Montenegrin First League]].

The club achieved its greatest success in 2026, when it defeated FK Dečić 1–0 in the final of the [[Montenegrin Cup|Montenegrin Cup]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://rtcg.me/sport/fudbal/848574/bar-slavi-evrogol-stefana-denkovica-mornar-osvojio-prvi-veliki-trofej-u-istoriji.html|title=Bar slavi evrogol Stefana Denkovića, Mornar osvojio prvi veliki trofej u istoriji|website=RTCG - Radio Televizija Crne Gore - Nacionalni javni servis}}</ref>."}}
